body: BLOCK exact 30f06fc3a46914c939a4ba703341311ebf464eda. Sole parent/base e584ad6; six declared paths; diff-check clean; raw-video exclusion, source identity, transforms, 17-source alias mapping, typed timebases, diagnostic authority, uncertainty, feature-use, and anti-circularity remain sound. The blocker is the successor delta itself: it reintroduces the participant recall prose external-until-REB condition that the chief rejected in decision 20260831T202824.071329Z as inconsistent with the binding owner directive. The candidate now says participant recall prose may only be processed locally and cannot enter Git/shareable bundles absent an owner-provided REB/IRB basis. Binding project policy says only actual Sherlock video files are excluded; Sherlock recall transcripts and all other non-video or derived artifacts may be stored and shared after their ordinary per-artifact provenance and story-text admission, without a Sherlock-wide BBC, consent, or REB hold. Required successor: restore that artifact-specific rule consistently across the same six paths; keep video bytes external; keep ordinary identity, transform, header, provenance, semantic-authority, uncertainty, and anti-circularity checks; do not characterize this as legal adjudication. A project-specific checklist reconciliation may clarify the exception, but it must not recreate the rejected REB gate. This is not artifact admission, landing authorization, or B0 closure.
